title: Nepal Red Cross - Bhotekoshi Flood Emergency Appeal
story: The Nepal Red Cross Society has activated its emergency response teams for the Bhotekoshi River flash flood affecting Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts. Funds will provide emergency shelter, clean water, and medical supplies to displaced families. NRCS is registered with the Social Welfare Council (SWC-REG-00123) and has 60+ years of disaster response experience in Nepal.

title: PM Disaster Relief Fund - Bhotekoshi Flood 2026
story: The Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund (PMDRF) is the official government channel for disaster donations in Nepal. All funds go directly to affected districts through the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA).

title: Rasuwa Youth Relief Coalition
story: We are a group of young volunteers from Rasuwa district directly affected by the Bhotekoshi flash flood. Our team is on the ground distributing food, tarpaulins, and medicines to families who lost homes in Dhunche and nearby villages. Registered with SWC (SWC-REG-00456).

title: Nuwakot Flood Victims Support Fund
story: Nuwakot district was severely hit by the Trishuli River flooding following the Bhotekoshi disaster. Many families in Bidur and surrounding VDCs have lost their homes and farmland.

story: Send crypto directly to help Nepal flood victims! Wallet: 0x7a3b...f92d (ETH/USDT). We are a decentralized collective ensuring 100% of funds reach victims through local partners. No middlemen, no overhead.

title: Dhading Flood Recovery Initiative
story: Dhading district was affected by downstream flooding from the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli river system. Our alliance of local NGOs (registered SWC-REG-00789) is coordinating a 6-month recovery program.

title: Trishuli River Flood - Medical Relief Campaign
story: Health for Nepal Foundation (SWC-REG-01011) is deploying mobile medical teams to Nuwakot and Rasuwa districts affected by the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli flash flood. Operating in Nepal since 2015 with proven post-disaster health response.
